name: scadnano
description: [scadnano](https://scadnano.org) ("scriptable-cadnano", [source code repository here](https://github.com/UC-Davis-molecular-computing/scadnano)) is a program for designing synthetic DNA structures such as DNA origami. The scadnano project is developed and maintained by the UC Davis Molecular Computing group. Note that [cadnano](https://cadnano.org) is a separate project, developed and maintained by the [Douglas lab](https://bionano.ucsf.edu/) at UCSF.

scripts.init: npm run setup:state_actions && npm run setup:reducers && npm run setup:webdev
scripts.setup:webdev: cd .. && dart pub get && dart run webdev build
scripts.setup:state_actions: cd .. && dart pub get && cd scadnano_state_actions && dart run build_runner build
scripts.setup:reducers: cd .. && dart pub get && cd scadnano_reducers && dart run build_runner build
scripts.build:win: npm run init && npm run build:electron:win
scripts.build:mac: npm run init && npm run build:electron:mac
scripts.build:lin: npm run init && npm run build:electron:lin

author: David Doty <doty@ucdavis.edu> (https://scadnano.org)
